svg.text: Protect sign-in and reduce routine privileges
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Microsoft Entra admin center and Azure Access control (IAM)
Enable or verify MFA using the free Security defaults where appropriate for your practice
tenant. Do not change an organization-wide policy in a tenant you do not administer.
Conditional Access and Intune have separate license requirements.
Use a scoped onboarding role for Arc and the documented security permissions for Defender
configuration. For daily reading, use a reader/security-reader role rather than retaining Owner
Cloud sign-in names can initially use your tenant.onmicrosoft.com domain. Verifying
lab.example.test in Entra is a separate public-DNS ownership step; do not replace nameservers or
mail records, and do not assume AD DS has synchronized automatically.
Check: Your sign-in is protected and daily investigation has narrower permissions than setup.
